title: Agents Are Becoming the Interface / Agent 正在成为新界面
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语精选版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 里，最值得注意的不是又多了几个 agent，而是 agent 正在改变我们使用软件、完成交易和组织工作的方式：界面退到后台，数据、权限和工作流反而变得更重要。与此同时，真正好用的 agent 仍然依赖克制的产品设计，而不是把更多 token 和更多功能一股脑塞给用户。

archive.title: Agent 重构日报
archive.desc: 从个人事务到企业软件，agent 正在接管更多操作，而新的竞争焦点转向上下文、护栏和可执行的工作流。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest.

sections.title: Agents as the New Interface / Agent 成为新界面
sections.desc: 当 agent 代替人浏览、沟通和执行任务，软件界面和广告模型都会受到重新审视。

rewrite: Peter Yang says his default communication layer is changing: he no longer lives in email or text, but in chats with his agents. The important shift is not another messaging preference; it is that the agent becomes the place where requests are interpreted and carried through.
original: Nah. I no longer live in email or text, I live in the chat with my agent(s). https://t.co/dh3JdEgVPN

rewrite: Peter Yang 说，他已经不再主要生活在 email 或短信里，而是在和 agent 的聊天中处理事情。真正的变化不只是沟通工具换了，而是 agent 开始成为理解需求、推动任务完成的工作入口。
original: 不，我已经不再生活在 email 或短信里了，我生活在和 agent 的聊天中。https://t.co/dh3JdEgVPN

rewrite: Peter Yang sees a coming shock for targeted display advertising: if agents browse sites and complete tasks without a human seeing the ads, the old impression-based model loses its audience. The agent-mediated web may force businesses to rethink what it means to be discoverable and valuable.
original:
I think we're in for a rude awakening in the ad markets:

If a huge part of your business is showing targeted display ads to humans what happens when agents browse your website and get the job done without a human seeing your ads at all?

rewrite: Peter Yang 认为，定向展示广告市场可能会迎来一次不太温柔的冲击：如果 agent 替用户浏览网站并完成任务，用户根本看不到广告，传统的曝光模型就失去了受众。未来企业要重新思考，如何在 agent 代为决策的网络里被发现、被理解、并证明自己有价值。
original: 我觉得广告市场会迎来一次不太好受的清醒时刻：如果你的大部分业务都是向人展示定向广告，那么当 agent 浏览你的网站、完成任务，而人根本没看到你的广告时，会发生什么？

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie argues that personal agents could increase commerce rather than merely reduce it. People will first delegate small, annoying tasks, then gradually trust agents with more complex purchases and services, creating room for both agent providers and the commerce infrastructure those agents need to use.
original:
The monetization potential of personal agents that are transacting on your behalf you is quite significant.

If you imagine agents that are perfectly capable of handling an arbitrarily complex task end to end, then eventually a substantial amount of commerce inevitably goes through them. 

You’ll start by slinging your daily simple and annoying tasks at the agent. Then as people get used to it, they’ll just start to throw more complex tasks at the agent, ultimately leading to even more spend through these systems than what they were doing before. If you can bring down the friction for commerce and services, then you end up spending even more. 

This thus creates a ton of opportunity for the agent providers (Muse, etc.), but also completely new opportunities to build the layer that the agents want to interact with (commerce, local, b2b services, etc.). Win/win for multiple layers.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，personal agent 不一定只会帮人省钱，也可能让交易变多。用户会先把琐碎任务交给 agent，等信任建立后，再把更复杂的购买和服务交给它，于是 agent 提供商和为 agent 准备的商业基础设施都会出现新机会。
original: 替你完成交易的 personal agent，其商业化潜力相当大。想象一下，如果 agent 能端到端处理任意复杂的任务，那么最终，大量商业活动不可避免地会通过它们完成。你会先把日常简单又烦人的任务丢给 agent，等习惯之后，再把更复杂的事情交给它，最终经由这些系统的消费可能比以前更多。降低商业和服务的摩擦，反而会带来更多消费。这既给 agent 提供商带来机会，也给 agent 要交互的商业、本地服务和 B2B 服务层带来全新机会。多个层都能受益。

sections.title: The Missing Layer Is Infrastructure / 被低估的是基础设施
sections.desc: 界面可以淡出，但数据、权限、业务逻辑和安全护栏会成为 agent 时代的核心底座。

rewrite: Aaron Levie predicts that agents will use software far more intensely than people do. That makes CRM, ERP, data platforms, security layers, guardrails and workflow orchestration more important, not less, because an agent can take destructive actions and depends on the quality of the context it receives.
original:
AI agents will use software 100X more than people ever did. Even as interfaces begin to fade into the background as you primarily interact with agents, those agents still need many of the core primitives that people have used.

In fact, in many ways these core primitives become even more important when agents can take destructive actions in our systems or where the context they’re accessing with make or break the workflow. This will be true of where you house your CRM or ERP or structured or unstructured data platforms.

The platforms that can best act as the security layer and guardrails for agents, manage the data for agents and people, and orchestrate the business logic for workflows have a huge opportunity right now. This is true for brand new startups as well as existing platforms that can move fast enough.

rewrite: Aaron Levie 预测，agent 对软件的使用强度可能是人的 100 倍。于是 CRM、ERP、数据平台、安全层、guardrail 和 workflow orchestration 不会变得不重要，反而更关键，因为 agent 可能执行破坏性操作，而它拿到的上下文质量会直接决定工作流成败。
original: AI agent 对软件的使用量会是人类曾经的 100 倍。即使界面逐渐退到后台，agent 仍然需要人类使用过的许多核心原语。事实上，当 agent 能在系统里执行破坏性操作，或者它访问的上下文决定工作流成败时，这些核心原语在很多方面会变得更重要。CRM、ERP，以及结构化或非结构化数据平台都会如此。现在，能为 agent 提供安全层和护栏、管理人和 agent 的数据、编排工作流业务逻辑的平台，都有巨大机会。新创业公司和能快速转型的既有平台都一样。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch points to a concrete infrastructure move: AI Gateway can now use Jev over HTTP, alongside the type-safe AI SDK API. It is a small-looking protocol update, but it reflects the broader race to make model and agent infrastructure easier to compose.
original: In addition to our type-safe TypeSafe @aisdk API (get it?), you can now use Jev over HTTP in AI Gateway https://t.co/u9OiIyILCE

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 分享了一项具体的基础设施更新：AI Gateway 现在可以通过 HTTP 使用 Jev，同时继续提供 type-safe 的 AI SDK API。看起来只是协议层的小变化，但它体现了更大的竞争：让 model 和 agent 基础设施更容易组合起来。
original: 除了我们的 type-safe TypeSafe @aisdk API（懂这个梗吗？），现在还可以在 AI Gateway 里通过 HTTP 使用 Jev。https://t.co/u9OiIyILCE

sections.title: Good Agents Need Restraint / 好 agent 需要克制
sections.desc: 工具越强，越不能把复杂度全甩给用户；真正的产品力来自筛选、上下文和清晰的执行路径。

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari pushes back on tokenmaxxing: companies that brag about using more tokens often ship worse product experiences. His point is a useful antidote to capability theater: good agent products still need curation and gardening, not a kitchen sink thrown at the model.
original:
With a few exceptions, the companies boasting about tokenmaxxing have the worst product experiences..

It’s because good products are all about curation & gardening and not throwing the kitchen sink at agents expecting them to figure it out. 

Less is more has never more apt.

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari 反对 tokenmaxxing：少数例外之外，那些大肆宣传 token 用量的公司，往往产品体验最差。这个判断提醒我们，agent 产品的关键仍是筛选和持续打磨，而不是把所有工具都扔给模型，期待它自己搞定一切。
original: 除了一些例外，那些吹嘘 tokenmaxxing 的公司，产品体验往往最差。因为好的产品讲究筛选和持续打磨，而不是把所有东西都扔给 agent，指望它自己想办法。‘少即是多’从未如此贴切。

rewrite: Thariq, who works on Claude Code, says he now types “use big pictures and few words” several times a day. The tiny instruction captures a practical design principle for agent output: when the goal is to help someone decide or act, visual structure and compression often beat more prose.
original: I now type "use big pictures and few words" several times a day

rewrite: 在 Claude Code 工作的 Thariq 说，他现在每天都会多次输入“用大图，少说字”。这句很短的指令其实点出了 agent 输出的实用原则：如果目标是帮助人做决定或行动，视觉结构和信息压缩往往比堆更多文字更有效。
original: 我现在每天都会输入好几次‘用大图，少说字’。

sections.title: Coding Agents Move Into the Workflow / Coding agent 进入主工作流
sections.desc: 当 agent 能够并行处理任务、追踪多步流程并直接产出 PR，软件开发的协作单位也在发生变化。

rewrite: Garry Tan says Capy can track multi-step workflows and complete large PRs faster than Codex or Claude Code on their own. The interesting part is not a benchmark claim; it is the workflow shape: an agent that can maintain state across a large change becomes a collaborator rather than a one-shot code generator.
original: Not really sure how @capydotai does it, but it really is able to track multi-step workflow and do large PRs faster than Codex or Claude Code on its own. My most favorite new agentic coding secret weapon in my arsenal the last week.

rewrite: Garry Tan 说，Capy 能追踪多步工作流，完成大型 PR 的速度比单独使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 更快。真正有意思的不是又一个 benchmark，而是工作方式变了：能在大型改动中保持状态的 agent，不再只是一次性代码生成器，而更像协作者。
original: 我不太确定 @capydotai 是怎么做到的，但它确实能追踪多步工作流，做大型 PR 的速度比单独使用 Codex 或 Claude Code 更快。它是我上周最喜欢的新 agentic coding 秘密武器。

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari describes Codex on Mac as especially strong at computer use and says it can one-shot workflows people normally perform manually. He also contrasts that with Instinct and Muse, which make browser use on a phone accessible with zero setup, suggesting the market is splitting between power tools for serious work and instant agents for everyone else.
original:
I have been using Codex as my primary "agent" for such a long time that I forget the average person has never used it..

Instinct and Muse are great especially for browser use on the phone. It shows what a great agent is like for the masses with ZERO setup. 

But, Codex on Mac is simply undefeated in all the work in can do with Computer Use (h/t @AriX and the Sky team). Like try doing a workflow that you do manually and give it Codex to one-shot. 

I can't wait to see what their latest launch will be as they reportedly get ready to release their "agent" to the masses. My only ask would be to showcase the work and make it easy for folks to get started.

Such a privileged time to be a customer for all these products - truly the golden age!

rewrite: Nikunj Kothari 说，Codex on Mac 在 computer use 上尤其强，很多原本需要手动完成的工作流可以直接让它 one-shot。他把 Instinct、Muse 在手机浏览器上的零设置体验也放在一起比较：市场可能正在分化，一边是为复杂工作准备的 power tool，另一边是让大众立即上手的 instant agent。
original: 我用 Codex 作为主要 agent 已经很久了，以至于忘了普通人可能从没用过它。Instinct 和 Muse 尤其适合在手机上使用浏览器，它展示了一个零设置、面向大众的好 agent 应该是什么样。但在 computer use 能完成的工作上，Mac 版 Codex 简直无敌。试试把一个你平时手动完成的工作流交给 Codex，让它 one-shot。听说他们正准备把最新的 agent 推向大众，我很期待；我唯一的要求是展示它能做什么，并让大家容易开始使用。能成为这些产品的用户，真是一个黄金时代。
